metadata.purpose: Plain Subject has no memory: values only reach current observers; late successful subscriber completes. An explicit connect() controls the source, not the number of observers.

conditions: Manual connection and observer subscription are separate operations; observers never automatically start or stop the source.
Plain Subject has no memory: values only reach current observers; late successful subscriber completes.
Unsubscribe of one observer is silent, and a source error forwards the exact error object.

scope.parameters: Selector-less legacy ConnectableObservable; one fixed Subject instance and explicit connect.
scope.callbacks: No user selector, projection or subscriber callback executes inside the pure model.
scope.time: No scheduler is added; source events occur at supplied times. Replay has infinite time window and count-only eviction. New subscriptions synchronously replay memory.
scope.reentrancy: Non-reentrant event delivery; source is not synchronous within connect() acquisition. Registered teardowns and one terminal connection only.
exclusions: Selector overloads of publish/publishReplay, timestamp-provider/windowTime expiration, arbitrary scheduler ties and getter side effects.
Reconnect after a terminal source notification, synchronous emission during connect(), observer callbacks that unsubscribe reentrantly.
RefCount auto-connection, arbitrary custom Subject subclass, throwing observer or teardown.

initialization.sourceSubscription: No source subscribed until explicit connect() is called; subscription to the connectable Subject may precede connect.

ownership.sharing: One fixed publish Subject and one explicitly owned upstream connection serve all observers of the same connectable instance.
ownership.reset: Explicit disconnect releases upstream but preserves subject and subscribers; source terminal stops the subject for this profile. New operator application makes a new instance.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Ordered Subject notifications with exact cache and terminal behavior; no callbacks or work are executed by the model.
cancellationCheckpoints: Observer cancellation never implicitly disconnects upstream.
Explicit disconnect is silent and retains observers; no next is legal without a source connection.
